Vista Del Mar Phuket

Villa in Nai Thon (Sakhu, Thalang)
HomeSaleVista Del Mar Phuket

Images published by the sales agent for this project: villa photos and renders by villa type.

Project overview

Vista Del Mar is a hillside villa estate in Sakhu, above Nai Thon Beach on the quieter north-west coast of Phuket. The villas are two storeys with private pools and sundecks, and come in named layouts from the three-bedroom Victoria (about 300 sqm) to the four-bedroom Monte and Grande (about 590 to 700 sqm); buyers can also order a custom design. Villas are built to order, with about 12 to 15 months of construction.

Nai Thon Beach is about 600 m away and the estate runs a shuttle to it. Shared services include a gym, restaurant, spa and beach club, with housekeeping, gardening and an in-villa chef on request. Phuket International Airport is roughly a 10-minute drive, which makes the location practical for owners who fly in and out often.

The published unit count varies between portals (from 18 to 22), so we do not state one. Foreign buyers take the land on a 30-year lease renewable twice.
